observations.summary: Reuters reported a US military official saying US fighter aircraft struck an IRGC missile-launch site on Qeshm Island in retaliation for Iranian targeting of US personnel and assets. Iranian local officials separately acknowledged US attacks but said no residential, commercial or infrastructure damage. Exact strike time and military damage remain unverified. This is distinct from the earlier Bahrain drone interception and follows it; it does not by itself establish a broader campaign.
observations.title: US official reports retaliatory strike on IRGC missile-launch site on Qeshm Island
